root_causes.description: The generation recipe parameters (likely CFG scale, sampler, steps combination) produce over-smoothed output. The V7 recipe prioritized identity fidelity over image sharpness, resulting in loss of natural detail.
root_causes.recommended_fix: Adjust CFG scale (try 5.0-6.0 range), change sampler to DPM++ 2M Karras with 30+ steps, reduce denoise to 0.85-0.90 range.

root_causes.description: The quality reference (V6 elderly portrait / бабка) was not sufficiently weighted in the generation conditioning. IP-Adapter or ControlNet strength for quality reference was too low, allowing the base model's smoothing tendency to dominate.
root_causes.recommended_fix: Increase quality reference IP-Adapter/ControlNet strength, ensure quality reference is used in conditioning chain, verify reference image dimensions match generation.

root_causes.description: The prompt contract did not adequately prescribe natural face detail (skin pores, realistic eyes, individual eyelashes, hair strands). Over-emphasis on identity consistency led to neglect of micro-detail requirements.
root_causes.recommended_fix: Add explicit prompt clauses for skin micro-detail, realistic eyes with clean eyelashes, natural mouth/teeth. Add corresponding negative prompts for smooth/wax/plastic artifacts.

root_causes.description: The SDXL checkpoint used has an inherent smoothing bias that produces wax/plastic skin at the CFG scales used. A different checkpoint or LoRA may be needed for natural skin detail.
root_causes.recommended_fix: Consider checkpoint with better skin detail characteristics, or add skin-detail LoRA. Reduce CFG scale to reduce smoothing effect.

root_causes.description: The generation pipeline did not include any post-processing sharpening, face detail enhancement, or upscaling step that could compensate for the softness.
root_causes.recommended_fix: Add post-processing sharpening node (e.g., Detailer, FaceDetailer, or Sharpen). Consider 2x upscale with detail preservation. Add face restoration pass.
